title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Event
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Event. Temporary and scheduled event, like a festival or competition (definition taken from Wikidata, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1656682). Restricted so that s4city:isOrganizedBy only ever points to a s4city:Agent (a person, organization, or public administration, since PublicAdministration instances are typically co-typed as Agent).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Event'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isOrganizedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isOrganizedBy'. The Agent (person, organization or public administration) that organizes the event. Restricted to s4city:Agent only.

hasAccessibility.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasAccessibility'. The AccessibilityConcept(s) (e.g. metro, wheelchair access) describing how the event can be accessed.

takesPlaceAtFacility.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/takesPlaceAtFacility'. The Facility the event takes place at.

takesPlaceAtTime.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/takesPlaceAtTime'. The time:TemporalEntity (instant or interval, from the W3C Time ontology) at which the event takes place.

isSubEventOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isSubEventOf'. A more general Event that this event is part of (e.g. a single basketball match that is part of a basketball week).
